about_the_game:
Only the strongest may be called Champions.

In Champions of Sparta, you step into the role of elite Spartan warriors chosen to represent Sparta in a series of deadly combat trials. Across seven unforgiving arenas, inspired by the world’s most powerful ancient empires, Spartan champions are tested through blood, skill, and sacrifice.

Each arena is a proving ground—designed to break the weak and forge legends.

Master Three Forms of Combat

Adapt or fall. Victory demands mastery of multiple combat styles:

  • Melee Combat
    Engage enemies up close using spear, shield, and raw Spartan brutality. Break defenses, execute finishers, and dominate the battlefield.

  • Ranged Combat
    Strike from a distance with precision and timing, controlling the arena before enemies close in.

  • Magic Combat
    Harness mythic powers drawn from ancient forces and gods, unleashing devastating abilities to turn the tide of battle.

Champions Rise Through Trials

Not one, but multiple champions fight for Sparta’s future.
Some arenas are conquered by male warriors, others by female warriors—each a symbol of Spartan excellence, discipline, and lethal skill.

Arena-Based Warfare

  • 7 handcrafted arenas inspired by ancient empires

  • Relentless enemy waves and powerful bosses

  • Combat-focused design with no distractions—only survival and mastery

Fight for Sparta

Every victory strengthens Sparta. Every fallen enemy brings it closer to supremacy.

Do you have what it takes to become a Champion of Sparta?

name: Champions of Sparta

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD Supported, SSD Recommended. The above specifications were tested with DLSS/FSR/XeSS enabled.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / INTEL Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required. The above specifications were tested with DLSS/FSR/XeSS enabled.

short_description: Champions of Sparta is a brutal action RPG where elite Spartan warriors face deadly arena trials across ancient empires. Master melee, ranged, and magic combat to prove your worth and secure Sparta’s path to domination.
